Department of Linguistics, Deccan College \(Deemed University\), Pune and Rajya Marathi Vikas Sanstha, Mumbai\.
Survey of dialects of the marathi language online\.
2026\.
Fieldwork 2018–2022\. Village\-aggregated lexical responses; 33 ambiguous tokens excluded\. Snapshot date is not the publication date\. Source transcription retained; no etymological claims\.
URL: [https://sdml\.ac\.in/data\-analysed](https://sdml.ac.in/data-analysed)\.
